tasks.subject: Task 3: lib/config.ts — config resolution + token cache + OAuth
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Config layer owns all credential and cache concerns. getConfig() + getToken() + clearToken(). Token file is 0600 on Unix. --no-cache/PEGA_NO_CACHE fully bypasses file reads and writes.

**Files:** src/lib/config.ts, test/helpers/mock-filesystem.ts, test/helpers/mock-pega-api.ts, test/lib/config.test.ts

**Verify:** `npm test -- test/lib/config.test.ts` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/config.ts", "test/helpers/mock-filesystem.ts", "test/helpers/mock-pega-api.ts", "test/lib/config.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- test/lib/config.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["env vars take precedence over file config", "missing config throws INVALID_CONFIG", "/prweb.* stripped from baseUrl", "token refresh when <60s remain", "--no-cache skips both read and write", "PEGA_NO_CACHE=true forces noCache", "OAuth POST has correct Basic auth + form body", "token file mode 0600 on Unix", "forceFresh ignores cache but still writes", "OAuth failure normalizes to NormalizedError"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
